title: MLTask input v1
description: Domain input payload for the ML adapter's normalize_task. Carries the task identity plus the machine-learning spine: the task type, the data specification, and the mandatory holdout policy. A task without an explicit holdout policy is inadmissible at the seam, because without it the permitted use of test and future-holdout partitions cannot be ruled out (declared-is-the-floor discipline, ADR-0008 decision 3). All timestamps are caller-injected; the adapter reads no clock.

task_id.description: Caller-allocated id for the mapped core research-task/v1 record.

study_id.description: Identifier of the study this task belongs to; tasks, claims, evidence, and cases of one study share it.

statement.description: Human-readable task statement, e.g. the learning problem or generalization question under study.

task_type.description: Learning-task family of the study: supervised classification or regression, time-series forecasting, or unsupervised clustering (the Phase 5 goal spans supervised, unsupervised, and time-series work).

data_spec.description: Data requirements of the study (sources, schema, scale, label space, drift expectations). Free-form in v1; the audit obligation lives in the M0 checkpoint.

holdout_policy.description: Mandatory holdout discipline statement: which validation/test/future-holdout partitions exist and what each may be used for. Required and non-blank; an absent holdout policy means test/holdout misuse cannot be ruled out at the seam.

scope.description: Passed through to the core task draft's scope.

resources.description: Passed through to the core task draft's resources envelope.

created_at.description: Caller-injected freeze timestamp; the adapter never reads a clock.
